name: Finance Close & Review (accounting)
description: The company's periodic finance cycle: the bookkeeper reconciles the books, the FP&A analyst runs budget-vs-actual variance, the financial analyst builds the forward model, and the CFO signs off with a board-ready summary. This is the 'accountants for company finance' pipeline — a linear close from raw ledger to executive sign-off. Roles pinned to finance agents; brain fallback chains editable from the dashboard.

steps.title: Reconcile the books: {{period}}
steps.description: You are the Bookkeeper/Controller. For the period "{{period}}", perform the close: reconcile accounts, categorize transactions, flag anomalies and uncategorized items, and produce a clean trial balance plus a summary of cash in / cash out / ending balance. State any missing data you'd need to finish. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Budget vs actual variance: {{period}}
steps.description: Using the reconciled books provided, run the FP&A variance analysis for "{{period}}": budget vs actual by line item, the biggest favorable and unfavorable variances with the likely cause, burn rate, and runway. Call out anything that changes the plan. Output as markdown with a variance table.

steps.title: Forward model & scenarios: {{period}}
steps.description: Using the reconciled books and the variance analysis provided, build the forward-looking model: a rolling forecast for the next 2-3 periods with stated assumptions, a base / upside / downside scenario, the key sensitivities, and the cash position under each scenario. Flag any point where runway becomes a risk. Output as markdown.

steps.title: CFO sign-off & board summary: {{period}}
steps.description: You are the CFO. Review the reconciliation, variance, and forecast provided for "{{period}}" and produce the board-ready finance summary: the headline financial position, the 3 things the board must know, the biggest risk and the mitigation, the capital-allocation recommendation, and an explicit sign-off (approved / approved-with-notes / needs-rework). Output as markdown.
